mainEntity.name: How do you confirm a 276DT engine fits my Discovery 3?

acceptedAnswer.text: We check your VIN or registration against the engine code, model year, emissions equipment and gearbox. TDV6 engines from the Range Rover Sport can differ in ancillaries and wiring, so compatibility is confirmed before supply.

mainEntity.name: How do used, reconditioned and rebuilt TDV6 engines compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: A used engine comes from a donor vehicle, a reconditioned engine is stripped and given new wear parts, and a rebuild restores your existing engine. We recommend an option after assessing the fault and vehicle.

mainEntity.name: Can I buy a Discovery 3 TDV6 engine supply only?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Trade buyers, independent garages and private customers with their own mechanic can buy supply only. Alternatively, choose supply and fit and our technicians will install the engine at our Grays, Essex workshop.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of a Discovery 3 276DT engine replacement?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost depends on the engine option, the condition of your current engine, any parts needed such as a turbo or oil cooler, and the labour involved in fitting. Send your registration or VIN for a written quote.

mainEntity.name: Is there a warranty on a replacement 276DT engine?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warranty cover depends on the engine option and whether we carry out the installation. We confirm the exact terms in writing with your quote, so you know what is covered before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Do you deliver 2.7 TDV6 engines across the UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver engines throughout the United Kingdom from our Grays workshop. Delivery arrangements and costs are confirmed in your quote, and supply and fit customers can bring their Discovery to us.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Discovery 3 engine replacement usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timescale depends on engine availability, whether a rebuild is needed, any body-lift work and additional repairs found during inspection. We give you an estimated timeframe with your quote and keep you informed.
